description: This file defines the NotificationsRepository class, responsible for fetching notification data either from a mock dataset or via an API call using a REST client. It provides functionality to retrieve a list of notifications, mapping JSON data to NotificationItem objects.

classes.name: NotificationsRepository
classes.description: Repository class dedicated to managing notification data retrieval, either from mocks or via API.

methods.name: listNotifications
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of NotificationItem objects either from mock data or via an API endpoint.
